personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, glove-friendly industrial tool built for speed, utility, and precision on the construction site.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 56pt height) and strict padding. Avoid unnecessary whitespace, use strong borders to group content.

do's: Avoid glassmorphism entirely; it clashes with the Brutalist/Utility aesthetic and reduces visibility in bright sunlight.
dont's: No blur effects, no translucent backgrounds. Rely on solid surfaces and strong borders.

screens.name: Dashboard / Home
screens.purpose: Provide quick access to recent estimates and a massive primary action to start a new one.

states.empty: Empty clipboard illustration + 'Brak aktywnych kosztorysów' + 'Nowa wycena' CTA.

screens.layout: Brutalist edge-to-edge layout. Top section contains user greeting. Below it, a massive, full-width 'Nowa Wycena' button in Signal Orange. Underneath, a list of 'Ostatnie wyceny' (Recent estimates) using hard 1pt borders to separate rows. High contrast, oversized typography for PLN amounts.

screens.name: Capture (Nowa Wycena)
screens.purpose: Capture field data (voice, photo, or text) for AI processing (Gemini 3.1 Pro + Whisper).

states.loading: Spinner with bold text 'AI analizuje miejsce i zakres prac...'

screens.layout: Camera viewfinder takes up the top 60% of the screen. Bottom 40% houses oversized, touch-friendly buttons for Voice Record, Snap Photo, and Text Note. Once input is gathered, a sticky bottom CTA 'Generuj kosztorys' appears.

screens.name: Estimate Editor
screens.purpose: Review and manually edit the AI-generated list of materials, labor, margins, and VAT.
screens.layout: List of editable rows separated by strong borders. Each row has oversized '+' and '-' buttons for quantities. Sticky bottom footer (outside scroll view) displays total Net/Gross PLN and a massive 'Generuj PDF' CTA. Use mono-spaced font for all numbers/amounts.

screens.name: Clients & Projects
screens.layout: Simple, high-contrast directory list. Full-width rows with strong borders. Massive 'Dodaj' (Add) button fixed at the bottom.

empty_clipboard.alt: clipboard and pencil isolated on white

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile Light aesthetic: no rounded corners (radius 0 everywhere), no drop shadows, and no glassmorphism.

The app targets construction workers outdoors: prioritize absolute maximum contrast (black text on stark white backgrounds) and massive touch targets (min 56pt) that can be easily tapped while wearing gloves.
Use Space Grotesk for all headings and primary CTAs to create a mechanical, structured look.
MANDATORY: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, but YOU MUST USE a monospaced variant or `fontVariant: ['tabular-nums']` for ALL costs, prices, quantities, and numeric data in the Estimate Editor.
Language is strictly Polish. Currency is PLN, VAT 23%.
Auth screen should feature the email/password fields and a Google sign-in option with brutalist hard borders.

For the Estimate Editor, ensure the 'Generuj PDF' CTA and total summary remain sticky at the bottom of the screen (in a safe-area respecting container) while the materials/labor list scrolls behind it.
Implement real haptics using `expo-haptics` on major interactions (like capturing media, adding/removing item quantities, and generating PDFs).
